input_messages.content: Hello! I'm having trouble sending MMS messages from my phone for the past few hours. I would really like to fix this so I can send pictures and messages to my family. Can you help me with that?
Sure, my phone number is 555-123-2002. My name is John Smith. Let me know if you need any other information to help with this.
I don't want to change my plan, so I think I'd like to refuel some data. Could you please add 2 GB to my plan? I hope that will fix the MMS issue.
Yes, please go ahead and add the 2 GB to my plan. Thank you.

Yes, please go ahead and add the 2 GB to my plan. Thank you. Also, could you please check if my mobile data is currently enabled? I want to make sure everything is set up correctly to send MMS messages.
Airplane Mode is off. The signal strength is poor. Mobile data is enabled. The network type is 2G. What should I do next?
I changed the network mode preference to 4G/5G preferred. Now the signal strength is excellent, and the network type is 5G. Mobile data is still enabled. What should I do next?
I checked, and my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. What should I do next?
The APN name is "internet" and the MMSC URL for picture messages is set to "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc". What should I do next?
Wi-Fi Calling is currently turned on. What should I do next?
I turned off Wi-Fi Calling, but my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. What should I try next? I'm getting a bit frustrated with this.
The messaging app currently only has permission for "phone." It does not have permissions for "storage" or "sms." What should I do next?
I granted the messaging app both the storage and sms permissions, but it still cannot send MMS messages. What else can I try? I'm really hoping to get this fixed soon.
The speed test failed and showed no connection. The VPN is turned off, and Data Saver mode is off as well. What should I do next? I'm worried about losing connection completely.
I restarted my phone, but the speed test still failed and shows no connection. I also tried sending an MMS, but it didn't work. What else can I try? This is really frustrating.

My SIM card is active and working. The signal strength is excellent, the network type is 5G, mobile data is enabled, and data roaming is off. What should I do next? I'm feeling quite overwhelmed with all these steps.

I reset the APN settings to default and restarted my phone, but the speed test still failed and shows no connection. I also tried sending an MMS, but it didn't work. Could you please transfer me to a human agent for further help? I'm really struggling with this.

user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.

Thanks, John. I found your line, 555-123-2002, which is on the Premium Plan. The plan has a 15 GB monthly data limit, and this line has used 15.1 GB this cycle. Once a line goes over its limit, mobile data stops working, and MMS needs mobile data. That is the likely cause.

You have two options:

2. **Change to a plan with more data.**

Which would you like? If you want to refuel, tell me how many GB you'd like to add.
I don't want to change my plan, so I think I'd like to refuel some data. Could you please add 2 GB to my plan? I hope that will fix the MMS issue.
